name: Bambu Lab P1S

warn.PC: Enclosed but no active chamber heating: fine for small parts, larger ones may warp.
warn.PA: Dry the filament first; passive enclosure only.
warn.PLA-CF: Abrasive: fit a hardened steel nozzle (stock nozzle is stainless steel).
warn.PETG-CF: Abrasive: fit a hardened steel nozzle (stock nozzle is stainless steel).
warn.PA-CF: Abrasive and warp-prone: hardened nozzle, dry filament.

notes: Open the lid or door for PLA/PETG so the chamber does not overheat.

clearance_mm.note: Starting values per side, for PLA at 0.2 mm layers. Replace with tolerance-coupon measurements.
